title: 评估Transformer和LSTM在无资料流域预测中的表现
summary: 该研究评估了仅编码器Transformer与LSTM在无资料流域上游径流推断中的表现。结果表明，LSTM整体性能优于Transformer，而加入下游信息可使中位数NNSE提升超60%。研究强调循环记忆更适合该任务，下游水文上下文能显著提升预测能力。
summary_en: This study evaluates encoder-only Transformer vs LSTM for upstream streamflow inference in ungauged basins. Results show LSTM outperforms Transformer, and incorporating downstream information boosts median NNSE by over 60%. Recurrent memory aligns better with the task, while downstream context improves prediction across architectures.
